title: Gifted-education advisor assigns ESP, crop circles and abduction stories

tellings.quote: I was consistently being assigned ESP. Eventually evolved into crop circles. She's like looking to abduction stories.

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that as a schoolboy, the teacher in charge of his gifted-students programme kept assigning him projects on ESP, meaning extrasensory perception, then on crop circles, the patterns flattened into farm fields, and then on stories of people taken by aliens. He tells it from his own memory, as an early nudge toward the subjects he later took up.
